text.body:
|| śrīmadramānujācāryaviracitaṃ tantrarahasyam ||
paśyan godāvarīmagre prāṅ‌mukhaḥ padmakāsanaḥ | narasiṃhavapurviṣṇuravyāddharmapure vasan || 1 || godāvarīrodhasi saṃniviṣṭā garīyasī dharmapurī cakāsti | tatrāvatīrṇasya nṛsiṃhamūrtterviṣṇoḥpadaṃ cetasi saṃsmarāmi || 2 || namāmi jaiminimuniṃ yena dvādaśalakṣaṇī | mīmāṃsā nirmitā sūtraiśśrutitātparyasiddhaye || 3 || sa jīyācchabarasvāmī nānāśākhāsu viśrutaḥ | sūtrārthaṃ viśadīkartuṃ yena bhāṣyamabhāṣyata || 4 || ālocya śabdabalamarthabalaṃ śrutīnāṃ ṭīkādvayaṃ vyaracayadbṛhatīṃ ca laghvīm || bhāṣyaṃ gabhīramadhikṛtya mitākṣaraṃ yaḥ so'yaṃ prabhākaragururjayati trilokyām || 5 || bṛhatīṃ tathaiva laghvīṃ ṭīkāmadhikṛtya śālikānāthaḥ | ṛjuvimalāṃ dīpaśikhāṃ viśadārthāmakṛta pañcikāṃ kramaśaḥ || 6|| tathā'nyāṃ śālikānātho nānāprakaraṇātmikām | mānameyavivekārthaṃ cakre yatnena pañcikām || 7|| ṭīkādvayaṃ pañcikāśca bhavanāthastu saṃkṣipan | cakre nayavivekākhyaṃ prabandhaṃ sarvasaṃmatam||8|| bhinnaṃ kkacitkutracidapyabhinnaṃ viruddhamekatra tathā'viruddham | tantradvayaṃ cāpi guruktarītyā vitanyate tantrarahasyaśikṣā || 9|| pūrvapūrvakṛtiṣu prapañcitaṃ mānameyamititatvanirṇayam | saṃkṣipāmi gurutantranītibhiḥ prītaye'tra viduṣāṃ mitākṣaram || 10 || anubhūtiḥ pramāṇaṃ, parīkṣakāṇām tatraiva pramāṇavyavahārāt| smṛtivyatiriktā ca saṃvit anubhūtiḥ | smṛtiśca saṃskāramātrajaṃ jñānam, tatraiva smṛtivyavahārāt | tatra saṃskāragrahaṇena pratyakṣādijñānavyudāsaḥ, teṣāṃ indriyādimātrajatvāt | mātragrahaṇena pratyabhijñāyāḥ vyudāsaḥ, tasyāssaṃskārasacivendriyajatvāt | smṛtyanubhavayorvivekaḥ prapañcayiṣyate || nanu smṛtirapi tvanmate yathārthā | sā kimiti na pramāṇam ? satyam - na hi yāthārthyaṃ prāmāṇyanimittaṃ, tasya sarvasaṃvitsādhāraṇatvāt | kiṃ tvanubhūtitvameva| smṛtistu satyapi tasmin kevalasaṃskārajanyatvena anubhūtivilakṣaṇā pūrvānubhūtamevārthaṃ tadityavarundhānā ca satī na svātanñyeṇārthaṃ paricchinattīti na pramāṇam | tadaṃśavikalasmṛtipramā'pi pratītipāratanñyābhāve'pi saṃskārajatvena na pramāṇameva | ata evobhayavidhapāratanñyābhāvādrṛhītagrāhitve'pi dhārāvāhikavittayaḥ pramāṇameva || kathaṃ yāthārthyaṃ sādhāraṇam ? sarvasyāpi jñānasyārthāvyabhicāritvena tanniyamāt| nanu kathamavyabhicāraḥ ? idaṃ rajataṃ pītaśśaḍakha ityāderviparyayasya, sthāṇurvā puruṣo vā ityādessaṃśayasya svapnasya vā'tathātvāt | rajatapratipattiśca purogatāṃ śuktimeva rajatatvenādhyavasyati| rajatamātragocaratve ca ' idaṃ rajatam ' iti sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ na syāt | rajatārthinaḥ purovartini śuktiśakale pravṛttirna syāt| avagatipravṛttyorekaviṣayatvaniyamāt | evaṃ ' pītaśśaṃkhaḥ ' ityādivittayo'pi anyathākhyātirupāḥ || kiṃ ca sādhāraṇe yāthārthye bhramābhramavibhāgaḥ kutaḥ ? tasya yāthārthyāyāthārthyanibandhanatvāt | ' nedaṃ ' iti bādhaśca kutaḥ ? tasya pūrvapratipannaviṣayāpahāralakṣaṇatvāt | yāthārthye ca tadayogāt | ucyate - yasyāṃ saṃvidi yo'rtho'vabhāsate sa tasyā viṣayaḥ, nānyaḥ, tasya tatrānavabhāsāt | anavabhāsamānasya viṣayatve'tiprasaṅ‌gāt| tenānyasya anyathābhānaṃ pratītiviruddhameva | tato'tra na rajatapratītiḥ śuktigocarā, tatra tasya anavabhāsāt | kiṃ tu rajatagocaraiva | nanu tarhi purovartini ' idaṃ rajataṃ ' iti viśiṣṭanirvāhaḥ katham ? ittham - prathamamindriyārthasannikarṣe sati śuktikāmātramāgṛhītaviśeṣadharmakaṃ idamiti sāmānyena gṛhyate| tadanu doṣavaśāt tadaṃśavikalaṃ tatsadṛśaṃ rajatamātraṃ smaryate| loke ca sadṛśadarśanātsadṛśasmṛtirdṛṣṭaiva | tacca smaraṇaṃ tadaṃśapramoṣādanubhavasamānākāram| etāvattāvadāvayoravivādam | tatra gṛhyamāṇasmaryamāṇayorgrahaṇasmaraṇayorvā bhedāgrahātkevalaṃ sāmānyākāropalambhādviśiṣṭavyavahāraḥ, na tu viśiṣṭadhītaḥ, tata eva pravṛttirapi yuktā| uttarakālaṃ ca bhedagrahaṇe vyavahāravisaṃvādbādho'pyupapannaḥ | sa ca na pūrvajñānaviṣayāpahāraḥ, tayoryathārthatvāt | kiṃ tu vyavahāravisaṃvāda eva | na hi jñānaṃ bādhyaṃ, tasya yathārthatvāt | kiṃ tu vyavahāraḥ | daśamādhyāyavicāragocaro bādho'pi vyavahārasyaiva, na tu jñānasya | tatra hi kṛṣṇaleṣvavaghātasya caruṣu peṣaṇasya cānuṣṭhānamātraṃ bādhyate, na tvaṅ‌gatvapratītiḥ, tasyāḥ pramāṇasiddhatvāt| tata eva samyaṅmithyāvibhāgo'pi| yatra vyavahāravisaṃvādaḥ tatra pūrvajñānasya bhrāntatvam| yatra tu na (vyavahāravisaṃvādaḥ) tatra samyaktvam || nanu uṣṇaṃ jalaṃ, śītaśśītamayūkhaḥ, suvarṇaṃ gurutaraṃ, ityādau vyavahārāvisaṃvādātsamyaktvaṃ syāt ? na syāt, tatrāpi bhedāgrahanibandhanatvātpratīteḥ | vidyamānamapi bhrāntatvaṃ na vyavahriyate || nanu bhavennāmedamaṃśo'nubhavaḥ, rajatāṃśastu kathaṃ smṛtiḥ ? tattāṃśapramoṣāt | na hi tatra taditi pratītirudeti| tato'nubhavatvamevocitam | satyam, na tāvaccākṣuṣo'nubhavaḥ, tadasaṃprayogāt | nāpyanumitiḥ, liṅ‌gābhāvāt| pariśeṣātsmṛtireva | tadaṃśapramoṣastu doṣavaśāt | ata eva pāmarāṇāṃ tatrānubhavavyavahāraḥ | parīkṣakāṇāṃ tvanyathā | gṛhītagocarasya tattārahitasyāpi kevalasaṃskāragocaratvāddhārāvāhikavailakṣaṇyamapi || nanu doṣāccākṣuṣo'pi viśiṣṭānubhava eva kiṃ na syāt ? na syāt | doṣāṇāṃ sahajakāryaśaktipratibandhakatvameva, na tu vilakṣaṇakāryajanakatvam | na hi doṣasahasrasaṃkulādapi śālibījādyavāṅ‌kurodayaḥ | kiṃ cānyathākhyātivādinā'pi bhavatā prathamaṃ grahaṇasmaraṇe aṅ‌gīkṛtyaiva tābhyāṃ viparyayo jāyata ityabhyupagatam| ata evātra smaryamāṇāropa iti bhavato vyavahāraḥ | asmākaṃ tu tābhyāmevāgṛhītabhedābhyāṃ bhrāntivyapadeśopapatteḥ pravṛttisaṃbhavācca na tṛtīyajñānāṅ‌gīkāraḥ, lāghavāt | yāthārthyaniyamabhaṅ‌gaścātrādhiko doṣaḥ || nanu yadgocaraṃ jñānaṃ tatraiva pravṛttiḥ | rajatajñānaṃ ca na śuktigocaram| ataḥ kathaṃ tatra pravṛttiriti cet ? satyam | samyagrajatasthale tathaiva| atra tu sākevalabhedāgrahanibandhanā | bhedāgrahaścātra bhavatā'pyaṅ‌gīkāryaḥ| anyathā bhrāntyanudayāt | na hi viśeṣagrahe tadudayaḥ, tannivartakatvāttasya| ata eva śuktiśakalaṃ rajatajñānagocaraṃ rajatārthipravṛttiviṣayatvāt samyagrajatavaditi tvadīyamanumānaṃ pratyuktam| avisaṃvādattatra tathā| atra tu naivaṃ, visaṃvādāt | kiṃ ca ghaṭaśabdaḥ paṭavācakaḥ, cakṣurgandhagrāhakamitivat pratijñāpadayorvyāghātaśca || ki ca jñānasyārthavyabhicāre pratīyamānastāvadākāro jñānamātraparyavasitaḥ syāt | tataśca sarvaṃ jñānaṃ sākāramāpatediti bāhyasamayasāṅ‌karyam | tathā pītaśaṅkhabodho'pi yathārtha eva| tathāhi - netravartini svacche pittadravye tadraśmibhissaha nirgate tadgatapītimā'tra gṛhyate | tathā doṣavacchaṅkhamātraṃ ca| dravyaguṇayossahapratītiniyamaśca nāsti, parasparasākāṅkṣayostayorvidyamāno'pyasaṃbandho na budhyate, tataśca tatrāsaṃbandhāgrahādviśiṣṭadhīvyavahāraḥ | pravṛttirapi tata eva| dvicandrajñāne'pyuṅ‌gulyavaṣṭambhādidoṣādvidhoḥ pravibhakto nāyanaraśmirekasmiṃścandramasi dvitvaṃ janayati | tatra dvitvasya candramasaścāsaṃbandhāgrahādvau candrāvityevaṃ vyavahāraḥ | tathā sarvatodiśamāśutarasaṃcāriṇyalātadaṇḍe'pi nirantaradhiyo jāyante| tatrāntarālāgrahaṇāccakrabuddhivyavahāraḥ | alāte ca cakravyavahāraḥ| tathā darpaṇe nayanaraśmirnipatitaḥ prathamaṃ saviśeṣaṃ darpaṇaṃ gṛhṇāti| paścāttu pratihataḥ parāvṛtto mukhamātram | tatra darpaṇasya mukhasya ca bhedāgrahāddarpaṇe mukhavyavahāraḥ| tadgatānāṃ savyadakṣiṇamahattvālpatvādidharmāṇāṃ mukhasya ca bhedāgrahāt | mukhe taddeśādivyavahāraśca || svapnastu smṛtireva | na hyananubhūte sa samudeti | doṣācca tattāpramoṣaḥ| grahaṇākāraśca adṛṣṭavaśādarthānāmanubhūtatvaṃ ca nādhyavasīyate | avasthāviśeṣo'dṛṣṭaṃ ca saṃskārodbodhakam | ata eva jāgratastādṛgeva dhīḥ || tathā saṃśayo'pi naikaṃ vijñānam | kintu dve ete sthāṇutvapuruṣatvagocare pramṛṣṭatattāṃśe parasparavinirmukte puraḥ sthitordhvavastudarśanājjāyamāne smṛtirupe | etatsarvaṃ yathārthameva | parasparavinirmuktayostayorviśeṣayoḥ puraḥsthite dharmiṇi ekasyāpi vyavasthā nāstīti vyavasthitavyavahāraṃ pravartayitā pravartayitumaśaknuvan saṃśeta iti bhavati tatra saṃśayavyavahāraḥ| kiṃ ca kasyacidbhānasyārthavyabhicāre sarvasyāpi tathātvaśaṅ‌kāyāṃ jagati viśvāso na syāt|| nanu tvanmate'pi kutracidbhāne bhedāgrahanibandhanapraghṛttau vyavahāravisaṃvāde sarvatra tathātvaśaṅ‌kāyāmaviśvāsastadavastha eveti cet na, vaiṣamyāt | yāthārthye hi sādhāraṇe ' yadbhānaṃ tatsatyam ' iti sarvatra svārasiko viśvāsaḥ | pravṛttiśca svārasikī | kkacidaviśvāse sopyalpāyāsena nivartate | pravṛttyuttarakālaṃ vyavahārāvisaṃvāde pūrvajñānasya viśiṣṭārthagocaratvaniścayāt| visaṃvāde tu kevalaṃ parasparavinirmuktā gṛhītabhedatattadvastugocaratvaniścayāt || atassarvaṃ jñānaṃ yathārtham | yāthārthye'pi smṛtirapramāṇam | anubhūtiḥ pramāṇamiti siddham || ācāryaistu - 'dṛḍhamavisaṃvādi agṛhītagrāhi vijñānaṃ pramāṇam ' iti pramāṇasāmānyalakṣaṇaṃ nibaddham | tacca prāmāṇyaṃ svataḥ, aprāmāṇyaṃ parata ityapi nibaddham | datuktam - tasmāddṛḍhaṃ yadutpannaṃ na visaṃvādamṛcchati | jñānāntareṇa vijñānaṃ tatpramāṇaṃ pratīyatām || iti | tacchiṣyaiśca tatsvatastvaṃ bahudhā prapañcitam| tathāhi - tatra keciditthaṃ vyācakhyuḥ - svaśabdo'yamātmīyavacanaḥ | prāmāṇyaṃ cārthatathātvam| jāyata iti ca yogyatayā'dhyāhriyate | tataścāyamarthaḥ - svīyādeva kāraṇādarthatathātvalakṣaṇaṃ prāmāṇyaṃ jāyate, na guṇāt, tasya doṣapratibandhamātra evopakṣīṇatvāt| guṇādhīne tu prāmāṇye vedasyāpauruṣeyatayā vaktṛguṇābhāvena prāmāṇyaṃ na syāt| etadvilakṣaṇamaprāmāṇyaṃ na svīyātkāraṇājjāyate, kintu doṣādityaprāmāṇyaṃ parataḥ| ata evedaṃ rajatamityādiṣu svīyātkāraṇādidamaṃśasya svatastvam | doṣāttu rajatāṃśasya mithyātvamiti || etanmatamācāryagranthānuguṇaṃ na bhavatīti tadīyairevopekṣitam || anye tu - svaśabdo'yamātmavacanaḥ | prāmāṇyaṃ cānadhigatatathābhūtārthaniścayaḥ| tataśca svatojñānasvarupāttādṛśaṃ prāmāṇyaṃ jāyate| na tu guṇajñānādarthakriyājñānādvā| aprāmaṇyaṃ tu parato doṣajñānādarthānyathātvajñānādveti | ayamapi pakṣastadīyaireva pratikṣiptaḥ | tatra tāvadaprāmāṇyasya parato janma yuktam | na hi rajatajñānasyāprāmāṇyaṃ doṣajñānādijanyaṃ, utpattāvevāpramāṇatvāt | atathābhūtārthaniścayo'prāmāṇyam| taccāpramāṇajñāne svata eva bhavati, na bādhakajñānādikamapekṣate | na hyutpattau pramāṇaṃ satpaścādbādhakenāpramāṇīkriyate| api tūtpattāveva jñātamaprāmāṇyaṃ paścādbādhakena jñāpyate | kiṃ ca prāmāṇyasyāpi svato janma ayuktam | svata iti jñānasvarupamatraṃ cedvivakṣitaṃ tadā mithyājñānasyāpi svataḥ prāmāṇyaṃ syāt, tatrāpi jñānasvarupasyāviśeṣāt | atha samyagjñānaṃ vivakṣitaṃ, tadā pramāṇajñānātprāmāṇyotpattiruktā syāt | tadā svasmātsvasyotpattissyāt, samyagjñānasvarupāvyatirekātprāmāṇyasya || apare tu - svaśabdo jñānaparaḥ| yogyatayā ca bhātītyadhyāhriyate | jñānāttadgataṃ prāmāṇyaṃ jñāpyate | aprāmāṇyaṃ tu parato gamyata iti | tadapi tadīyaireva nirastam | na hi jñānamātmānamātmīyaṃ vā prāmāmyaṃ gṛhṇāti, tasyārthagrahaṇamātropakṣīṇatvāt| na hyutpannaṃ jñānamahaṃ pramāṇaṃ madīyaṃ vā prāmāṇyamiti pratibhāti | jñānaṃ tu kevalamarthaprakāśānyathānupapattyā kalpyate | prāmāṇyamapi tata eva | tasmātsvato bhātītyanupapannamiti || ācāryamatatatvavedinastu - svaśabdo'yamātmavacanaḥ | prāmāṇyaṃ cārthavattvam| bhātīti cādhyāhāraḥ | jñānasvarupādevārthatathātvalakṣaṇaṃ prāmāṇyaṃ bhātīti jñānamātrasyārthatathātvaprakāśakatvaṃ svārasikamiti yāvaditi | taduktaṃ tadīyaiḥ - ātmavācī svaśabdo'yaṃ svato bhāti pramāṇatā | arthasya ca tathābhāvaḥ prāmāṇyamiti gīyate|| yadarthatathātvaṃ yadvaśācca jñānaṃ pramāṇaṃ tadbhānaṃ svarupādeva bhāti, na tu guṇajñānādarthakriyājñānātsaṃvādajñānādvetyautsargikaṃ prāmāṇyam| arthānyathātvalakṣaṇamaprāmāṇyaṃ na svato bhāti| kintu kāraṇadoṣajñānānnedamiti vādhakajñānādveti parata ityupapāditamaprāmāṇyamiti| yathāhurācāryāḥ - tasmātsvataḥ pramāṇatvaṃ sarvatrautsargikaṃ sthitam| bhādhakāraṇaduṣṭatvajñānābhyāṃ tadapodyate || iti | sthitaṃ prāptaṃ pratipannamiti yāvat | sarvatreti na kevalaṃ pramāṇeṣu kintu jñānamātra ityarthaḥ | na hi pramāṇajñānānyadhikṛtyeyaṃ cintā, yata autsargikatvaṃ na syāt | kiṃ nāma saṃśayasmṛtivilakṣaṇāni ? tayoraprāmāṇyasya spaṣṭatvāt na tau vicāragocarau | yadi pramāṇajñānānyadhikṛtyeyaṃ cintā syāt tadā teṣāmeva svataḥ prāmāṇyaṃ sādhitaṃ syāt | tathā ca vedasyobhayavādisiddhaprāmāṇyābhāvena vicārāviṣayatvānna tatsādhitaṃ syāt | tathā ca tatprāmāṇyānupayoginī cintā kākadantaparīkṣāvadakartavyā syāt | jñānamātrādhikāreṇa tu svataḥ prāmāṇye sādhite vedasyāpi sāmānyataḥ prāptaṃ prāmāṇyaṃ kāraṇadoṣāderabhāvānnirapavādamiti saprayojanā syāditi prāmāṇyamautsargikam, anyadāpavādikam || nanvarthatathātvaṃ prāmāṇyaṃ cetsmṛterapi tatprasaṅgaḥ | tayā'pi tathātvaniścayāt| maivam| adhigatatayā'nanusandhānam, arthasya ca tathātvam, jñānasya ca tatra niścayajanaktavamiti tritayamapi prāmāṇyamabhimataṃ loke | tatraiva pramāṇaśabdapravṛtteḥ| ato na smṛteḥ prāmāmyam | tadayamatra pūrvottarapakṣasaṅkṣepaḥ - ghaṭapadācca ghaṭajñānodayadarśanāt ghaṭasadasadbhāvamātrasādhāraṇena jñānamātreṇa ghaṭo durniścayaḥ | ato na tasya svataḥ prāmāṇyaniścayaḥ | kintvarthakriyājñānātsaṃvādād‌guṇavatkāraṇajñānādvā tanniścayaḥ| kriyājñānamavyabhicārātsvata eva pramāṇam | saṃvādo'pyarthatathātvādeva ghaṭate| tathā guṇo'pi | tasmātparata eva prāmāṇyaniścayaḥ na svata iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ || siddhāntastu - na jñānamavyabhicārāniścayamukhenārthaṃ niścinoti| kintu svata eva | yadi svato niścetuṃ na śaknuyāt taṃdā niścayasyātyantāsambhava ityāndhyamevāśeṣasya jagato bhavet | na hi svato'niścitorthaḥ parato'pi niścetuṃ śakyate, parasyāpi pūrvavadevāsāmarthyāt | yathā ghaṭajñānamasatyapi ghaṭe dṛṣṭam ityaniścāyakaṃ tathā'rthakriyājñānamapi svapnāvasthāyāmasatyāmeva ca tasyāṃ dṛṣṭamiti na kenāpi sā niścetuṃ śakyate | tayā ghaṭaniścayastu dūrata eva | tathā saṃvādo nāma tadviṣayaṃ jñānāntaram | tasya pūrvajñānātko viśeṣaḥ ? yena tenāniścitamanena niścīyeta| tathā guṇajñānādapi guṇo niścetuṃ na śakyate | kiṃ punaḥ pūrvajñānaprāmāṇyam | tasmātsvata eva pramāṇyaṃ paratastvapramāṇyaṃ doṣajñāmādbādhakajñānādvā | vede tu akalpite vahirbhāve gṛhābhāve ca nirṇīte ' jīvati vā na vā ' iti saṃdeha eva bhavati| kalpite tu tasmin sa praśāmyati| arthasaṃdehāpādako'rthaḥ pramāṇam | vahirbhāvakalpanā pramā | kalpyamāno'rthaḥ prameyam| yadvā pramitiḥ pramāṇamiti vyutpattyā kalpanā pramāṇam | tadanantarabhāvi viśiṣṭajñānaṃ phalamiti || nanu gṛhābhāvadarśanādbahirbhāvakalpanamanumānameva | tathāhi - devadatto bahirasti gṛhe avidyamānatve sati jīvanavattvāt, yo jīvaṃstatra nāsti sa tato'nyatrāsti, yathāham, iti cet ? maivaṃ - jīvanāṃśe saṃdigdhāsaṃdigdhatvāt | nanu jīvanaṃ pramāṇāntarapratipannaṃ kathaṃ saṃdigdham ? satyaṃ pramite hi vastuni pūrvapratipannarūpādrūpāntaraprāptau saṃdeho bhavatyeva | pūrvaṃ hi jīvanaṃ gṛhasaṃbaddhameva pramitam | saṃprati tatsaṃbandhe nivṛtte bahirdeśasaṃbandhe cākalpite jīvane saṃdeho bhavatyeva | ' pūrvaṃ jīvan devadatto gṛha eva dṛṣṭaḥ | idānīṃ sa gṛhe nāsti jīvati vā na vā ' iti| tarhi bahirdeśasaṃbandhakalpanādasadigdhaṃ jīvanaṃ liṃgamiti cet (evaṃ cet) anumeyābhāvaḥ| bahirdeśasaṃbandha eva anumitsitaḥ| sa tu nirṇotaścedanumeyaṃ nāvaśiṣyate| kevalagṛhābhāvo'pi na liṅgaṃ, mṛtajaniṣyamāṇayorvyabhicārāt | ato'tra nānumānāvakāśaḥ | atasasaṃdehāpādako'rtho'rthāpattiriti sthitam | na hi dhūmādikaṃ kasyacidarthasya saṃśayāpādanadvāreṇa liṅgamiti tato vaiṣamyam| tathā pīno devadatto divā na bhuṅ‌kta ityatrākalpite rātribhojane pīnatā rātribhojane pramāṇam || taduktam - tatsaṃdehavyudāsāya kalpanā yā pravartate | saṃdehāpādakādarthādarthāpattirasau smṛtā || iti| anye punarevaṃ menire - yasminnakalpite yo'rthaḥ pratīto'pi pūrvaparidṛṣṭasvarūpaparivṛttyā saṃśayarupāmanupapattiṃ bhajate so'rthaḥ svagatasaṃdehavyudāsāya arthāntarakalpanāyāṃ pramāṇam | yathā pūrvoktaṃ jīvanasāmānyaṃ bhojanamātraṃ ca| dhūmādyanumānaṃ naitādṛśaṃ, ekatrāniścitakaraṇamaparatra saṃdigdhamiti tato vaiṣamyam || taduktam - yatkalpanāṃ vinā yo'rthaḥ pratīto'pyeti saṃśayam | tena tatkalpanāmeke tvarthāpattiṃ pracakṣate || iti || kecittu gṛhābhāva evānyathā'nupapadyamānassanvahirbhāvakalpanāyāṃ pramāṇamityāhuḥ | tadayuktam | tatra gṛhābhāvasya kā'nupapattiḥ ? asati bahissattve svasyābhāva iti cet, tarhi sādhyābhāve hetvabhāvaripovyatireka eva | sa ca hetusadbhāve sādhyasadbhāvalakṣaṇenānvayenāvagamyata ityanvayavyatirekamukhena pravartamānatvādidamanumānameveti nārthāpatteḥ pṛthakprāmāṇyasaṃbhavaḥ | atassaṃdehāpādako'rthastenāpāditasaṃdeho'rtho vā'rthāpattiriti sthitam || atra kecit - yatrārthānupapattiḥ pramāṇāntarapratipannā tatrārthāntarameva kalpyamiti sā dṛṣṭārthāpattiḥ | yatra tu vākyapratipannā ' pīno devadatto divā na bhuṅ‌kte 'iti tatra ' rātrau bhuṅ‌kte ' iti vākyameva kalpyam | ' śābdī hyākāṅkṣā śabdenaiva paripūryate ' iti nyāyāt | atassā śrutārthāpattiriti arthāpattidvaividhyamāhuḥ| tadayuktam| atrāpyarthasyaiva kalpayitumucitatvāt | yasminnakalpite'nupapattiḥ kalpite tu tacchāntiḥ ataḥ tadeva kalpyaṃ anyathā hyavyutpannapadavākyaprayoge tu tacchāntiriti tadeva kalpyamiti| tarhi padārthajñānādeva tacchāntiriti arthaparikalpanamevocatam| ubhayaparikalpane gauravaṃ ca | dṛṣṭārthāpattāvarthasyaiva kalpyatvaṃ dṛṣṭamiti tadevātrāpi kalpyatām | śābdī hyākāṅkṣā kalpitārthānvayenāpi śāmyati, tasyaivākāṃṅkṣitatvāt | ata eva ' dvāram ' ityādau adhyāhārasthale buddhistenaiva saṃvaraṇādinā'nvitāmidhānaṃ na tu ' saṃvriyatām ' ityadhyāhṛtena, śabdena buddhisannihitenāpyanvitāmidhānopapatteḥ| jijñāsāvaśena kkacitparaṃ prati śabdaprayogasaṃbhavaḥ, na tu niyamena || nanvarthakalpanāya pravṛttārthāpattiḥ tasyārthasya savikalpakajñānaviṣayatvāt| teṣāṃ ca śabdapurassaratvāttadvācakaśabdaparyantaṃ vyāpriyata iti cenna | sarvatra savikalpakapratyakṣe svārthānumāne ca tadabhāvāt | na hi te śabdaparyantaṃ vyāpriyete, vadhiramūkatiraścāṃ tadasaṃbhāvāt | kiṃtvarthamātre | kiṃ ca sarvatra savikalpakajñāneṣu hi sa śabdaśravaṇaviparivarto, na tu prameyam| arthadarśanāddhi vācakaśabdassmaryata iti vicārāsahametat | śabdaṃ tu pramāṇaṃ svāvasare nirupayiṣyāmaḥ | tasmādarthāpattyā saha pañca pramāṇāni | etatsarvaṃ pramāṇapārāyaṇe prapañcitam | vedārthavicārānupayogānnāsmākaṃ tatrātinirbandhaḥ || || abhāvapramāṇanirāsaḥ || abhāvākhyaṃ ṣaṣṭhe pramāṇamabhāvagrahaṇāya kaiścidaṅ‌gīkriyate | abhāvasya bhāvavilakṣaṇatayā bhāvarupapramāṇena tadgrahaṇāśakteḥ pañcapramāṇānutpattirupamabhāvarupaṃ pramāṇameṣitavyamiti | tadayuktaṃ, prameyābhāvāt | nanu kathaṃ tadabhāvaḥ ? ' iha bhūtale ghaṭo nāsti ' iti tāvadasti pratītiḥ | sā kiṃ bhūtalasvarūpaviṣayā, atha kevalaṃ tadviṣayā ? nādyaḥ, ghaṭavatyapi prasaṅ‌gāt | na dvitīyaḥ, pūrvoktadoṣānativṛtteḥ| dvitīye tvabhāvāṅ‌gīkāraḥ | kiṃ ca kaṇṭakādivirahiṇi bhūtalādau niśśaṅ‌kaḥ padanyāsādivyavahārastāvatkiṃ bhūtalamātraparicchedanibandhanaḥ ? atha kevalabhūtalaparicchedaḥ | tathā ca sūkṣmakaṇṭakādiṣvanavagateṣvapi niśśaṅ‌kavyavahāraḥ syāt | prayatnapūrvikā tajjijñāsā ca nih‌nutā syāt | dvitīye tvabhāvākhyaṃ prameyamaṅgīkṛtaṃ syāt | tadānīṃ hi tatparicchedanibandhano vyavahāro yuktaḥ| pratiyogiparāmarśarthaṃ jijñāsā ca| kiṃ cābhāvānaṅgīkāre nāstiśabdo nirarthakaḥ syāt| śaśādīnāṃ śṛṅgānumānaṃ syāt | idaṃ rajatamityasya bādhaśca na syāt | tadaṅ‌gīkāre tu sārthakaḥ | vādhitaviṣayatvaṃ cānumānasya yuktam | bādhaśca yuktaḥ | tasmādasti bhāvavilakṣaṇaṃ tatvāntaramiti || idamidānīṃ vicārayāmaḥ - kiṃ tadbhāvapramāṇabodhyaṃ, utābhāvabodhyamiti ? tatra na tāvatpratyakṣabodhyaṃ indriyavyāpāroparame'pyavagateḥ | kathamayaṃ nirṇayaḥ ? abhāvastāvatkutracitkasyacitpratyetavyaḥ iha tanneti | tataśca yatra pratyetavyaḥ tad‌grahaṇa evendriyamuparamate | nābhāvagrahaṇe, tena saha saṃbandhābhāvāt | tasmādabhāvapramāṇagocarobhāvaḥ | kathamayaṃ vibhāgo'vasitaḥ ? ucyate - gṛhādisvarupamanubhūya deśāntaragataḥ puruṣaḥ vastvantarābhāvapraśne sati bhāvāntaraṃ jijñāsamānasya praṣṭustathaiva nāstītyuttaraṃ pratipadyate || taduktam - svarūpamātraṃ draṣṭā ca paścātkiṃcitsamarannapi | tatrāsya nāstitāṃ pṛṣṭaḥ tathaiva pratipadyate || iti || na ca tatrendriyavyāpārassamasti, deśaviprakarṣāt| tasmādabhāvapratītirnaindriyikī | tena pratyakṣo'bhāvo na śakyo vaktum | tatra pūrvamevābhāvo gṛhītaḥ paścādbuddhistha iti ca na vaktuṃ śakyate, pratiyoginastadānīṃ buddhāvanārohāt | na ca nirvikalpakena pūrvamanubhūtaḥ paścātsavikalpakena smaryata iti vācyam | niyamena pratiyogisammitaveṣasyābhāvasya sarvadā nirvikalpakāgocaratvāt | tatsaṃbhave vā smṛtirapi tādśī syāt, yathānubhavaṃ smṛteḥ || nāpyanumānaṃ liṅgābhāvāt | na hyatra abhāvavyāptaṃ liṅgamupalabhyate| upapānārthāpattyoranavasara eva| tasmāttatratatra bhāvapramāṇapañcakānutpattirevābhāvāvagame pramāṇam|| nanu pramāṇānutpattirliṅgatayā pramāṇaṃ syāt ? na | ubhayorapyabhāvātmakatvena bhāvagrāhakapramāṇena tayorvyāptigrahāsaṃbhavāt | tasmādabhāvākhyaṃ pramāṇaṃ svamahimnaiva svaviṣayamupasthāpayati || kecittu dṛśyābhāvasthale dṛśyānupalabdhiḥ pramāṇam | anyatra tu bhāvarupamabhāvarupaṃ yathāyogyaṃ pramāṇaṃ syadityāhuḥ | tasmātprameyasadbhāvādabhāvākhyaṃ pramāṇamaṅgīkartavyamiti || atrocyate - dvividhā tāvadbhūtalādīnāmavagatiḥ, ekā saṃsṛṣṭaviṣayā, aparā tadekaviṣayā | sā'pi dvidhā - pratiyoginyadṛśye dṛśye ca | tatra dṛśye pratiyogini yā tadekaviṣayā buddhissaiva tasya pratiyogino'bhāva ityucyate | na hi tadekaviṣayabuddhimātramabhāvaḥ, viśeṣānavagamāt, kintu dṛśye pratiyogini | tataśca yasmin pratiyogini dṛśye yā tadekaviṣayā buddhiḥ sā tadabhāva iti viśeṣavyapadeśalābhaḥ | teneha bhūtale ghaṭo nāstītyukte ghaṭe dṛśye bhūtalamātraṃ nābodhītyuktaṃ bhavati || nanu kimidaṃ pratiyogini dṛśyatvaṃ nāma ? anyatra pramitasya anyatra prasaktirititvanmatasthitiḥ | anyathā aprasaktapratiṣedhāpātāt | saivāstu dṛśyatā| asmākaṃ tu jñānaviśeṣaḥ | yo'pyabhāvākhyaṃ tatvamaṅ‌gīkurute | tenāpi tadekaviṣayāṃ buddhimaṅ‌gīkṛtyaivābhāvapratītiriṣyate, adhikaraṇapratīteḥ | pratiyogiprasakteśca tatpratītikāraṇatvāt | tatra kīdṛśasyādhikaraṇasya pratītistatkāraṇamiti cintanīyam | kiṃ sadvitīyasya, athābhāvaviśiṣṭasya, athānapesyaikākina, iti ? nādyaḥ, ghaṭaghaṭite'pyadhikaraṇe pratīte tadabhāvapratiprasaṅ‌gāt | na dvitīyaḥ, ātmāśrayāt| abhāvaṃ hi pratītya tadviśiṣṭamadhikaraṇaṃ buddhvā paścātsa evābhāvaḥ pratipattavya ityabhāvāvagatirevābhāvāvagamakāraṇaṃ yataḥ, ato'pratīte'pyabhāve svarūpamātrapratītiraṅ‌gīkāryeti | tṛtīyaḥ pakṣaḥ pariśiṣyate - tāvataivābhāvavyavahāropapattau kimatiriktatatvāntarābhyupagamena ? nīlapītādivattādṛśatatvāntarānupalambhāt | ' vāyuparamāṇavo nīlarūpāḥ, salilaparamāṇavogandhaśūnyāḥ, ityādiṣvanumānātmikā tadekaviṣayā buddhiḥ | ayaṃ bhāvaḥ - caturvidheṣvabhāveṣu yasya yasyābhāvasya yadyadadhikaraṇaṃ tvanmate dṛśye pratiyogini tattadadhikaraṇamātragocarā buddhirevāsmākamabhāva iti | nāstiśabdaśca tādṛśādhikaraṇamātravācakaḥ | nañ‌śabdaśca svarupamātrapara iti hi prābhākarāḥ| niśśaṅ‌kapadanyāsādivyavahāro'pi tadekaviṣayabuddhimātranimittakaḥ | jijñāsā'pi dṛśyatvāpattaye yuktaiva | tathā pratyakṣabādho liṅ‌gabādhaśca tadekaviṣayabuddhimātranimittako vyavahārabādhamātranimittako vā | śuktikāyāṃ rajatavyavahāro liṅgābhāse liṅ‌gavyavahāraśca bādhyate | na hi jñānaṃ bādhyate | kintu vyavahāra eveti prābhākarāḥ || nanu yadyabhāvo'paro nāsti tarhi yatra prāksaṃsargabuddhirāsīt tatra kathaṃ tadekaviṣayā buddhirāvirbhavati | tvanmate vā kathaṃ tatrābhāvapratītiḥ ? mudgrarābhighātādivaśāditi cet, tata evāsmākamapi tadekaviṣayā buddhirjanyate|etena deśāntaraṃ nītasya ghaṭasya tatra sthitireva tadekaviṣayabuddhinimittamiti vyākhyātam | nanu yadyabhāvo'paro nāsti tarhi mudgrarābhighātādinā kapālamālotpattau yatra tadekaviṣayā buddhistatra paścātsaṃsṛṣṭaviṣayā'pi na syāt | tvanmate vā kimiti na syāt ? tatra bhāvavināśāditi cet, asmākamapi tathā syāt | tarhyabhāvāṅ‌gīkāra iti cet, vayamapi vināśamaṅ‌gīkurmaḥ, na tu bhāvāntarodaya eva | bhāva eva tvekākī sadvitīyaśceti dvayīmavasthāṃ labhate| tatraikākī bhāvodaya eva vināśaśabdavācyaḥ| tvanmate'pi tāddaśyavasthā'vaśyāṅ‌gīkāryetyadhastāduktam | evaṃ niranvayavināśiṣvapi buddhiprabhṛtiṣu dharmiṇaḥ svarūpāvasthānameva bhāvāntarodayo'vagantavyaḥ | kiṃca pramāṇāntaravādino'pyanupalabdhilakṣaṇā pramāṇānutpattirna sattayā'bhāvabodhikā, svāpādau sarvābhāvapratītiprasaṅgāt | kiṃca kasyacidvastunaḥ kutracitpūrvamadṛṣṭasya pūnastasminneva deśe dṛśyamānasya darśanasamānakālīno'bhāvo'vasīyate idamiha pūrvaṃ nāsīditi | tataśca tasyaṃ darśanāddarśanābhāvo nivṛtta iti prākkālīna evaṃ darśanābhāvo'nusandhīyamāno'bhāvapratītikāraṇamiti vaktavyam | tataśca viditaivānupalabdhirabhāvapratītikāraṇamiti vaktavyam | tathā cānupalabdherapyabhāvarupatayā tadbhānamapyanupalamyamityanavasthā | tadekaviṣayā buddhiścetsvayaṃ prakāśatayā na pramāṇāntarāpekṣaṇī | tasmātpramāṇānavaklṛptirapi na| tanmahimnā prameyāvaklṛptiriti pañcaiva pramāṇānīti sidbham | śābdaṃ svāvasare vakṣyāmaḥ| etatsarvamamṛtakalāyāṃ śālikānāthena samarthitam || iti śrīmadrāmānujācāryaviracite tantrarahasye pramāṇaparicchedaḥ prathamaḥ ||
|| atha prameyaparicchedaḥ || || atha prameyavargo nirupyate || tatra cābhyupagamasiddhāntanyāyena kaṇādatantrasiddha eva prameyavargo'ṅ‌gīkriyate, tasya tatpratipādanārthaṃ pravṛttatvāt | na tu pṛthagatra vyutpādyate | tatrāpyanabhimatāṃśo nirākriyate | viśeṣāṃśastu vyutpādyate | tathāhi - dravyaguṇakarmasāmānyasamavāyaśaktisaṃkhyāsādṛśyānyaṣṭau padārthāḥ || tatra dravyāṇi pṛthivyaptejovāyvākāśakāladigātmamanāṃsi nava || tatra vāyuḥ pratyakṣa eva, na tu tadgratasparśa eva pratyakṣaḥ, śītoṣṇasparśabhede'pi ' sa eva vāyuḥ, ' iti pratyabhijñānāt | nanvanuṣṇāśītasparśo vāyuḥ, sa kathaṃ tadbhede pratyabhijñāyate (na) sphadikavadupapattiḥ | yathā hi śuklo'pi sphaṭikaḥ tattadaupādhikaguṇasaṃbandhe'pi ' yo'yaṃ śuklassa evāyaṃ raktaḥ' ityāśrayāṃśe pratyabhijñāyate || tatra pṛthivyeva śarīrārambhikā, netarāṇi bhūtāni, tadanupalambhāt | idānīntanastrīpuṃsaparamaparāyāśca tathā darśanāt | viparītamasadeva | tacca jarāyujāṇḍajasvedajabhedena triprakārameva | udbhijjaṃ tu vṛkṣādikaṃ na śarīraṃ, bhogānupalambhāt | tadāyatanaṃ hi tatprayojakam | yadapi - śmaśāne jāyate vṛkṣaḥ kaṅkagṛdhropasevitaḥ || śarīrajaiḥ karmadoṣairyāti sthāvaratāṃ naraḥ || iti vacanaṃ tadvidhiparatantratayā na svatantram, ' yajamānaḥ paśuḥ, ādityo yūpaḥ' itivat pramāṇavirodhāt | tathā ātmā ca na mānasapratyakṣaḥ, karmakartṛbhāvavirodhāt | ' māṃ jānāmi ' iti vyapadeśastu bhāktaḥ | kintu viṣayeṣu prakāśamāneṣu jñānāśrayatayā prakāśate| sarvā'pi saṃvit tritayaprakāśikā | avaśyaṃ jñāturanubhavo meyānubhaveṣvanuvartate| anyathā svaparasaṃvedyayoranatiśayaḥ syāt | viṣayaissahopalambhaniyamaśca evaṃ satyupapannaḥ | na hyātmā viṣayānanuvidbho'vabhāsate | viṣayāśca boddharyanavabhāsamāne bhāsante | tasmātsaiva saṃvidviṣye pramāṇam | saiva puruṣaṃ viṣayīkarotīti, tatsaṃvittiphalabhāgitve'pi puruṣasya na karmatā, kartṛtaiva| parasamavetakriyāphalaśāli karmeti karmajñāḥ | ato na mānasapratyakṣaḥ || tamo nāma dravyāntaraṃ na bhavati | andhānāmiva kevalaṃ nīlimābhimānaḥ| apavāritālokaṃ kevalaṃ bhūbhāgādikameva chāyā || guṇāstu ruparasagandhasparśaparimāṇapṛthaktvasaṃyogavibhāgaparatvāparatvagurutvadravatvasnehasaṃskāraśabdabuddhisukhaduḥkhecchādveṣaprayatnadharmāḥ || eteṣāṃ nityānityavibhāgastathotpattisthitivināśaprakāraśca kaṇādatantrasiddhaḥ| vedārthavicārānupayogānnāsmākaṃ tatrābhiniveśaḥ|| karma tu nityānumeyam | saṃyogavibhāgaparamparayā hi gatiranumīyate| deśāddeśāntaraprāptyā sūryagatyanumānaṃ bhāṣye prapañcitam | idameva karma svatassādhyatayā sākṣādvidheyam | siddhasvabhāvayostu dravyaguṇayostaduparāgāt | svataḥ ' dadhnā juhoti ' iti homoparaktatayaiva dadhi vidhīyate | tathā ' aruṇayā krīṇāti ' ityāruṇyamapi || jātistu pratyakṣadravyamātre vartate, nānyatra, anupalambhāt | itthaṃ hi tasyāḥ pratītiḥ - pratyakṣeṣu ghaṭapaṭādidravyeṣu tattadāśrayagrāhakairindriyaiḥ saṃyuktasamavāyādgṛhyamāṇā nānāvyaktiṣu svayamekākāratayā tāmyo'tyantavilakṣaṇā prathamapiṇḍagrahaṇe svarūpamātreṇa pratīyamānā dvitīyādipiṇḍagrahaṇeṣu saiveyamiti pūrvākārāvamarśena pratyabhijñāyamānā pāmaraparīkṣakāviśeṣeṇa prakāśate | taduktam - jātirāśrayato bhinnā pratyakṣajñānagocarā | pūrvākārāvamarśena varṇānyatve pramāṇam | kiṃ ca varṇānāṃ vācakatve kramabhede vaktṛbhede vilamboccāraṇe cārthapratyayassyāditi, naitatsāram - yatnenānveṣaṇe'pi nānāvarṇavyatirekeṇa nirbhāgaśabdatatvānupalambhāt| pratipattigauravāt | niyatakramā varṇā eva hi padamityuktam | kiṃ cānenaiva nyāyena vākyāryapratītyupapattau tatra vākyaṃ parikalpya tatra tasya vyutpattirvaktavyā | tatrāpi bhūyān pratipattau gauravakleśa iti pratyakṣato'numānato vā na varṇātiriktaśabdatatvasaṃbhava iti || apare tu varṇānāṃ pratyekaṃ (padārtha) vācakatve'tiprasaṅ‌gāt āśutaravinā śitvena yugapad‌grahaṇabhāvācca pakṣadvaye'pyubhayoraniyatatvācca || atra navyāstu padairabhihitāḥ svārthāḥ smāritā vā padārthā akāṅ‌kṣādiyuktā vākyārthaṃ gamayantīti, tadapyanupapannaṃ, śaktikalpanāgauravāt | tathāhi - padārtheṣu vākyārthabodhanaśaktimādadhati | teṣāṃ tadutpādanaśaktirapareti | nanu pramāṇāntarapratipannāmapi saṃsargabodhanasāmarthyaṃ dṛśyate | tathāhi - yena nāma pratyakṣeṇājñātāśrayaṃ śvaitvaṃ pratipannaṃ heṣāraveṇājñātarūpo'śvo'numitaḥ ravurapuṭaniṣpeṣaśabdena cājñātakartṛkaṃ gamanamanumitaṃ tasya śveto'śvo dhāvatīti saṃsargabodho dṛśyate || taduktam - ' paśyataḥ śvetamārūpaṃ heṣāśabdaṃ ca śṛṇvataḥ | khuraniṣpeṣaśabdaṃ ca śveto'śvo dhāvatīti dhīḥ | dṛṣṭā vākyavinirmuktā'iti || ārupamavyaktarupam | avyaktāśrayamiti yāvat, maivam - tādṛśasya puṃsassaṃsargapratītireva nodeti, kiṃ tu śvetaṃ padasmāritāḥ padārthāḥ vākyārthaṃ gamayeyuḥ | tathāhi - padaśravaṇe vyutpattidaśāyāṃ pratisaṃbandhitayānubhūtāḥ padārthāḥ smaryante | asti ca saṃbandhyantaradarśane sabandhyantarasmaraṇam| taduktam - laukikapadānāmarthāsaṃsparśitvadarśanātsarvāpyapi padānyarthāsaṃsparśīnīti kathaṃ teṣāṃ prāmāṇyam ? arthapratītistu kevalaṃ śabdasāhacaryaprabhavatayā bhrāntireva, na tvavyabhicāriṇīti niyamaḥ | nanu śuktikārajatādivallaukikavākyānāṃ kāraṇadoṣeṇa duṣṭatayā bhedāgrahāt bhrāntatvaṃ yuktam | vaidikānāṃ tu nirdoṣatayā svābhāvikaṃ niścāyakatvameveti cenna | doṣāsaṃbhavādyuktaṃ sākṣādindriyajanyatayā rajatajñānasya taddoṣāduṣṭatvam | iha tu śabda eva hi sākṣātpratyāyakaḥ, vaktārastu kevalaṃ śabdābhivyañjakāḥ | taddoṣāśca na teṣu saṃkrāmanti | ato laukikānāṃ svato'rthāsaṃsparśitvaṃ, vaidikāśca na laukikebhyo bhidyante| atasteṣāmapyarthāsaṃsparśitvaṃ syāt | kiṃ ca vyutpattiśca loke, tataśca sutarām | nanu tarhi kathamāptavākyebhyaḥ pravṛttiḥ ? kathaṃ vā saṃvādaḥ ? na, tatra saṃdehādapi tadupapatteḥ| kṛṣyādiṣu saṃdehādapi hi pravartante | saṃvādaśca yādṛcchikaḥ | api ca laukikeṣu mānāntaravaśenāpyarthanirṇayassyādeva | vede tu vakturabhāvāttadarthasya mānāntarāgocaratvācca na tatra nirṇaya ityarthāsaṃsparśina eva vedāḥ | atrocyate - arthāsaṃsparśe jagati śabdamūlā pravṛttirna syāt| tatpratipādanaṃ ca na ghaṭeta, tasyāpi śabdamūlatvāt | yathākathaṃcitsaṃsparśe niyatā pravṛttirna syāt| tasmāttatsaṃsparśā'ṅ‌gīkāryaḥ | tatra laukikaṃ padajātaṃ tāvat liṅgatayā'rthapratyāyakaṃ, na tu svayaṃ pramāṇatvena | tatra yadyapi śabdārthayossaṃbandhastāvadautpattikaḥ | tatparijñānaṃ ca śaktigrahāt | sa ca vṛddhavyavahārapravartitāyāṃ vyutpattau gṛhītasaṃbandhaṃ ca padajātaṃ svarasato'rthapratyāyakamityetāvatsarvajanasammatam, tathāpi laukikavākyeṣu vaktṛdoṣaśaṅ‌kayā sā śaktistirodhīyate | tathāhi - tatra puruṣā bhramātiśayadoṣapramādāśaktibhinanvitārthāni vākyāni prayuñjānā dṛśyante | taddṛṣṭāntabalena sarvatrāpyananvitārthatvaśaṅkāyāṃ laukikaṃ vākyaṃ śrutamātraṃ nārthaniścāyakaṃ, yāvadvākyasya pramāṇamūlatvaṃ na niścitam | paścāttu, kadācidapyananvitārthāni vākyāni na prayuṅ‌kte | arthaṃ jñātvaivānyonyānvayayogyārthaṃ padajātaṃ bravīti | tasmādāpta ityāptatvaniścaye sati paścāttasmādvākyātkāryabhūtātkāraṇabhūtaṃ vaktṛjñānamanumīyate, idaṃ vākyaṃ svārthasaṃsargajñānapūrvakaṃ, āptavākyatvāt, madīyavākyavat | paścāttu tajjñānamarthāvinābhāvi, jñānatvāt, madīyajñānavaditi jñānenārtho'numīyate | itthaṃ vākyārthe niścite sati paścāttadeva vākyamud‌buddhaśaktikaṃ sattasyārthasya vācakam | tasyāṃ daśāyāṃ anumitārthabodhakatvādanuvādakameva, na tu pramāṇam | tasmāllaukikaṃ vākyaṃ liṅgatayaiva pramāṇaṃ, na tu svataḥ | anāptavākyaṃ celliṅgābhāsa eva, vyabhicārāt | śabdasya tu na kkacidapi vyabhicāro'sti | tasya tu śāstrarūpasya svata eva pramāṇatvāt | laukikaṃ tu vākyaṃ na śāstraṃ, kiṃ tu liṅgam | atastadeva vyabhicāri | vicāryamāṇeliṅgasyāpi na vyabhicāraḥ | pratyayitavacanādapratyayitavacanaṃ vivekenāpratipadyamānapratyayitavacane dṛṣṭam | grahaṇāpūrvakatvavyavahāramapratyayitavacane pravartayatīti na liṅgasyāpi vyabhicāraḥ | tasmāllaukikamāptavākyamanuvādadaśāyāmarthasaṃsparśi | anāptavākyaṃ cetkevalaṃ svasvārthasmārakatayā arthāsaṃsparśīti siddham | vede tu, vakturabhāvāt asati śaktipratibandhe svarasaprāptaṃ vācakatvaṃ susthamevetyaryasaṃsparśina eva vedāḥ| nanu laukikāni padāni liṅgatayā bodhakāni cet, kathaṃ teṣāṃ svasvārthe śaktigrahaḥ ? ucyate - na hi dhūmavadavinābhāvabalenaivānumāpakaṃ, kiṃ tu vācakaśaktyantarbhāvabalenaiva | na hi yaktiṃcicchabdamātrādyaktiṃcidarthamātramanumīyate, kiṃ tu viśiṣṭacchabdādviśiṣṭo'rthaḥ | vācakatvameva śabdasya viśeṣaḥ, vācyatvamevacārthasya | tataśca prathamaṃ vṛddhavyavahāre pūrvoktena mārgeṇa vācakācchabdādvācyārthavyutpattau satyāṃ kutaścitkāraṇādarthavyabhicāraśaṅkāyāṃ paścāttasminnevārthe tasya śabdasya liṅgatvaṃ, tataḥ paścādanuvādakatayā'pi vācakatvamiti vyutpattisamaye'nuvādasamaye ca śaktigrahaṇamupapannamiti gambhīro'yaṃ nyāyamahāhradaḥ || nanu pratyayitatvajñānena vyabhicāraśaṅ‌kāyāṃ nivṛttāyāṃ vākyaṃ svata evārthe pramāṇaṃ syāt, kimiti vaktṛjñānānumānaṃ bhavet | maivam, pratyayitatvaṃ nāma samīcīnajñānapūrvakavākyaprayoktṛtvam | jñānasya samīcīnatvaniścayaścārthaniścayamantareṇa na syāditi na saṃśayanivāraṇamātre puruṣaviśeṣajñānaṃ vyāpriyate, kiṃtvarthaniścaye'pi| nanu tarhi niścite'rthe saṃśaye ca nivṛtte paścāttatra pramāṇaṃ syāt, na syāt, tasyāṃ daśāyāṃ anuvādakatvādityasakṛduktam | nanu yadi vākyādvaktṛjñānānumānaṃ, jñānāccārthānumānaṃ, tarhyanavagate'rthe kathaṃ jñānaviśeṣo'numātuṃ śakyate, jñānamātraṃ ca nānumeyam, aprayojakatvāt | arthenaiva jñānasya viśeṣaḥ, taduktam -
arthenaiva viśeṣo hi nirākāratayā dhiyām| iti || na cānavagato'rtho jñānasya viśeṣamāpādayatīti prathamata evārthaviśeṣasaṃghaṭitaṃ jñānamanumīyatām, kimiti paścājjñānenārthānumānam ? ucyate - vumutsākrameṇa hyanumānaṃ, kāryabhūtasya vākyasya prathamaṃ sāmānyākāreṇa svārthasaṃsargajñānapūrvakatvamātraṃ bubhutsitam, tataścānavagate'pyarthaviśeṣe tādṛśajñānaviśeṣo'numātuṃ śakyata eva | yādṛśārthapratipādanayogyāni padāni tādṛśārthajñānapūrvakāṇīti | itthaṃ jñāne'numite, paścāttena jñānenārtho'numīyata iti bumutsākrameṇānumānadvayapravṛttiriti na kiṃcidanupapannam | etatsarvaṃ nītipathe prakaṭitam || nanu bhāratādivatpadasaṃghātātmakatayā vedaḥ pauruṣeyassyāt, ata eva kaṭhaśākhā kaṇvaśākheti samākhyā, na ceyaṃ pravacananimittā, tasya sarvādhyetṛsādhāraṇatvāt| bahavo hi prabrūyuḥ, kartā punarasādhāraṇaḥ, asādhāraṇena hi vyapadeśo yuktaḥ| pauruṣeyatve ca vedasya tadarthasya pramāṇāntarāgocaratvāttadviṣaye vaktuḥ pramāṇāntarābhāvādapramāṇamūlatayā'nanvitārthatvaśaṅ‌kā syādeveti cet, maivam, puruṣakṛtatvaṃ tāvadbhāratādivanna smaryate | vaiyāsikī bhāratasaṃhitā, pārāśarī viṣṇupurāṇasaṃhiteti smaryate | duranumānaṃ ca, mānāntarāgocare'rthe puruṣāṇāṃ vākyaracanānupapatteḥ, samākhyā tu pauruṣeyī pramāṇāntarānusāriṇī na svayaṃ pauruṣeyatvaṃ vyavasthāpayituṃ śaknoti, pramāṇāntaraṃ ca na dṛśyate | tasmātpravacananimittā kaṭhādisamākhyā, prakṛṣṭaṃ vacanaṃ kasyacideveti tadapyasādhāraṇam| adhyayānadhyāyādivyavasthayā'dhīyamānasya vrataniyamaviśeṣapūrvakasya vyākaraṇānuśiṣṭasya svarato viśeṣaniyatasyānuṣṭhānaparyantasyāvisaṃvādipaścannādyaihikaphalasādhanasya śiṣṭajanaparigṛhītasya mahato grantharāśerbhrāntapuruṣapraṇītatvaśaṅ‌kā ca niravakāśā| kkacitkavacidviprakīrṇaviruddhāprasiddhārthatayā'prāmāṇyamapi nāśaṅ‌kanīyaṃ, niruktavyākaraṇamīmāṃsādimukhena samīcīnārthatvanirṇayasiddheḥ | pramāṇāntarāgocarasya apūrvātmakasya vedārthasyabuddhāvāropayitumaśakyatayā buddhimatpraṇītatvamapi nāśaṅ‌kanīyam| na hi darśapūrṇamāsādyapūrvaṃ pratyakṣādipramāṇagocaraḥ | kiṃ tu taccodanāmātragocaraḥ| tadāha sūtrakāraḥ - " satsaṃprayoge puruṣasyendriyāṇāṃ buddhijanma tatpratyakṣamanimittaṃ vidyamānopalambhanatvāt | codanālakṣaṇo'rtho dharmaḥ " iti ca || tasmādapauruṣeyo vedaḥ | padasaṃghātātmakatvaṃ coccāraṇavaśādupapannam| taduccāraṇamuccāraṇāntarapūrvakam, tacca tathā | apauruṣeyatayā ca pramāṇāntarapūrvakatā nāsti, pratyakṣavat | ata eva cānapekṣatayā vedaprāmāṇyamiti || nanu ' citrayā yajeta paśukāmaḥ, ityādicodanāḥ paśvādiphalānuviddhaṃ svamarthamavabodhayanti | na ca karmānantaraphalaṃ dṛśyate | dṛśyamānamapi pratigrahādinimittameva | ataḥ pramāṇāntarabādhānna pramāṇam | ucyate - na tāvacchāstreṇānantarabhāvitayā phalaṃ jñāpyate, kiṃ tu phalasādhanatvamātramapūrvasya | na ca pratigrahādikamapūrvasādhanatvaparipanthi, tatsādhanatve'pyapūrvasādhanatvāvirodhāt | ataḥ pratyakṣādisiddhaṃ pratigrahādikaṃ śāstrasiddhamapūrvamubhayamapi phalasādhanamiti | ato veda eva śāstraṃ pṛthakpramāṇam | tatra laukikaṃ vākyaṃ liṅgatayā pratyāyakam | tattu, na śāstraṃ, asannikṛṣṭaviṣayatvābhāvāt | vaidikameva śāstramiti siddham | tattu dvividhaṃ pratyakṣamanumānaṃ ca | tatrādyapadhyayanaparigṛhītasvādhyāyātmako vedarāśiḥ | dvatīyastu nityānumeyaḥ | tatra liṅgaṃ smṛtiḥ ācāraśca | tathāhi - ' aṣṭakā kartavyā ' iti smṛtistāvat traivarṇikairavigānena parigṛhītā | na cāmūlāyāḥ parigraha upapadyate | na ca pratyakṣaṃ mūlaṃ, tasyāpūrvaviṣayatvāsaṃbhavāt | smṛtistu kāryaviṣayā | tataśśāstrameva mūlam | nanu tadapi kathaṃ mūlaṃ, yatnenānveṣaṇe'pyanupalabdheḥ | anupalabdhasya cābodhakatvāt ? ucyate - smṛtipraṇetāra eva vayamiva tacchāstraṃ nopalabhante| tatsamānārthasmṛtyantaradarśanena teṣāmapyasmākamivānumānaṃ saṃbhavatyeva| evaṃ manvādibhyaḥ pūrveṣāmapi smartṛṇāṃ tatsamānārthasmṛtyantaradarśanenānumānam| itthamānāditvātsmartṛparamparāyā liṅgabhūtāyāśca smṛtiparamparāyā nānumānatvavighātaḥ| ata eva nāndhaparamparāvadamūlatvamapi, anumitasya śāstrasya arthapratipādakatvaṃ ca lipyanumitākṣaravadupapannam | anantacaraṇādhāre hi mahīmaṇḍale kutracidapyaśravaṇamanāmnānāt, tadeva katham, ācāryāntarānāmnānāt ? tadapi kutaḥ ? tathaiva | tata eva nityānumeyatvaṃ vedatvaṃ ca, tasyāpauruṣeyaprabandharupatvāt | ata eva smṛtīnāṃ viprakīrṇaśākhāmūlatvamapi paroktaṃ nirastaṃ, kkacitkadācitkenacidapyanupalambhāt | tathā śiṣṭatraivarṇikaparigṛhītāviruddhācāreṇāpi sākṣācchrutiranumīyate, mūlāntarāsaṃbhavāt | ācārātsmṛtistataḥśrutiriti paṃroktamayuktaṃ, paramparāyāṃ pramāṇāsaṃbhavāt | tasmāddvividhaṃ śāstram| ubhayamapyasannikṛṣṭārthaviṣayam | sa ca kāryātmā, sarveṣāmapi śabdānāṃ sākṣātparamparayā vā loke kāryaparatvavyutpatteḥ | vaidikānāmapi lokāviśeṣāt| tathāhi - yathā madhyamavṛddhapravṛttirjñānapūrvikā, tathā kāryajñānapūrvikā ca, na hi jñānamātrātpravartate, kiṃ tu kāryameva taditi jñātvā | iṣṭasādhanatājñānasya pravartakatvamagre nirākariṣyate| tacca kāryajñānaṃ śabdānantarabhāvitvācchabdajanyam | tasmiṃśca kārye liṅloṭ‌tabyapratyayā evānvayavyatirekābhyāmavadhāritaśaktikāḥ, tatasteṣāṃ sākṣāttatparatvam, itareṣāṃ tu paramparayā | tathāhi - ' devadatta gāmānaya śuklāṃ daṇḍena ' ityādau vidhipratyayaḥ sākṣādānayateḥ kāryatāṃ bodhayati | ānayatistu kriyāṃ, gopadaṃ tadanvitaṃ karma| evamitarāṇyapi kārakapadāni tadanvitaṃ svārtham, anvite vyutpatteḥ | tathā ' jyotiṣṭomena svargakāmo yajeta ' ityādau vaidikapadānāmapi kāryaparatvaṃ draṣṭavyam| etaccopariṣṭātprapañcayiṣyate| tasmātsarveṣāmapi kāryaparatvavyutpatteḥ tatparatvaṃ siddham | nanu siddhārthaparādapi vākyād‌vyutpattiḥ dṛśyate | kathaṃ tanmātraparatvam ? tathāhi - ' putraste jātaḥ, kṣetraṃ te pakkasasyam ' ityādiprayoge mukhaprasādādiliṅgaiḥ śroturharṣotpattiranumīyate, sā ca tannimittamantareṇa na saṃbhavati | priyavastupratītiśca harṣaheturiti svātmani pratītam | tena vākyena priyo'rtho bodhita iti sāmānyena pratīte pariśeṣātpramāṇāntarapratipannaṃ putrajanmaiva vākyapratipādyamiti vyutpitsuravagacchati | tasmātpratipadamāvāpodvāpābhyāṃ viśepārthaniścayo bhavati| tathā ' kāṣṭhaiḥ pacati ' ityādau, vartamānaprayoge | vyutpannavibhaktaythau'vyutpannaprātipadikārthaśca pratyakṣeṇa kāṣṭhānāṃ karaṇabhāvamadhigacchan prasiddhapacatipadasamabhivyāhārātkāṣṭhaśabdārthaṃ niścinoti| kiṃ cāsya śabdasyāyamartha ityapi loke vyutpattirdṛśyate | api ca siddhārthaparāṇyapi vākyāni loke praśrnottaraparāṇi dṛśyante | ' kuśalaṃ te, kuśalaṃ mama iti '| ataḥ kāryamātraparatvamanupapannamiti || atrocyate - sarvapuruṣāṇāmādyā vyutpattistāvad‌vṛddhavyavahārata evetyavivādam| vyavahāraśca pratyakṣeṇa viśiṣṭārthaviṣaya upalabhyate | sa ca kāryāvagamamūlaḥ, tasyaiva pravartakatvāt | ataḥ kāryānvite viśiṣṭārthe jñānānumānadvāreṇa śabdasya śaktigrahassukara eva | nātra pariśeṣāpekṣā, vyavahāraviṣayasya viśiṣṭārthasya pratyakṣasiddhatvāt | siddhārthākhyāne tu vyutpattirduśśakaiva | yadyapi tatparavākyaprayoge mukhaprasādādibhiḥ harṣotpattiranumīyate | tayā ca taddhetupratītiḥ, tannimittatā'pi śabdasyaiva | tathāpi pariśeṣātpramāṇāntarasiddhaputrajanmākhyaharṣahetupratipādakatā duranumānā, kālatrayavartināṃ sannihitavyavahitānāṃ pramāṇāntarasiddhānāṃ harṣahetūnāṃ pāriśepyādavadhāraṇāyogāt | tathā asya śabdasyāyamartha ityatrāpi sarvapadārthāparijñāne vyutpattirduśśakaiva | katipayapadārthajñāne tu prasiddhapadasamabhivyāhāra eva | tatra prasiddhānāṃ pūrvaṃ kāryānvitasvārthe vyutpatteraprasiddhārthasyāpi padasya kāryādhyāhāreṇaiva tadanvitasvārthāvagatireṣaṇīyā | tataśca sarvapadānāṃ tatparatvaṃ siddham | evaṃ ca loke yassiddhārthaparassa lākṣāṇika eva, kāryaparaṃ padajātaṃ parasparapadārthānvayā vyabhicārīti kāryānvayamavivakṣitvā. parasparapadārthanvayamātraṃ vivakṣitvā lokaśśabdaṃ prayuṅ‌kte| vivākṣāvaśena lakṣaṇayā'pi tatra tātparyaṃ nirvahatyeva | vede tu lakṣaṇānibandhanaṃ kiṃcidapi neti autsargikaṃ kāryaparatvamanavagraham | tataśca siddhabrahmaparāṇāṃ siddhaparātmaparāṇāṃ ca ' satyaṃjñānamanantaṃ brahma, vijñānamānandaṃ brahma, tenedaṃ pūrṇaṃ puruṣeṇa sarvaṃ, yassarvajñassarvavit, dve brahmaṇī veditavyaṃ paraṃ cāparaṃ ca, dvā suparṇā sayujā sakhāyā samānaṃ vṛkṣaṃ pariṣasvajāte '| ityādividhinaikavākyatāmāśritya kāryaparatvaṃ varṇanīyam | ' bhūtaṃ bhavyāya ' iti nyāyāt | sādhyaśeṣabhūtaṃ siddhamiti nyāyādityarthaḥ | itthaṃ varṇā nityāḥ | arthāśca pravāharūpeṇa | tatsaṃbandhaścāpauruṣeyaḥ| tatparijñānaṃ ca śaktigrahāt | śaktigrahaśca vṛddhavyavahāreṇa | sa ca kāryānvitasvārthe| tatra padānyeva kāryānvitasvārthabodhakāni, na tvakhaṇḍaṃ śabdatatvaṃ, nāpyantyo varṇaḥ, nāpi padapratipāditāḥ padārthāḥ, tatra laukikaṃ padamanumānarūpaṃ, na śāstraṃ, asannikṛṣṭārthaṃvaidikameva śāstram | tadapi dvividhamityuktam | lakṣaṇavyāvartyacintātu arthagrahaṇenābhidheyavacanena | laiṅ‌gikaṃ vaktrabhiprāyajñānamaśāstramityuktam| asannikṛṣṭārthamiti pauruṣeyavākyābhidheyasyārthasya vaktrabhiprāyaniścayapurassaraṃ yadvijñānaṃ tanna śāstramiti | tathā'rthavādānāṃ svatantrāṇāṃ sannikṛṣṭārthaparāṇāṃ na śāstratvaṃ, kiṃ tu vidhyantarānupraveśenaiva | śabdagrahaṇena cārthasya jñānasya cāśāstratvamuktam | tathāhi - prakṛtau ' vāsasi minoti vāsasā somamupāvaharati ' iti somabhānamupāvaharaṇaṃ ca vihitam | tatraikatvātkarmaṇo yasminneva vāsasi somo mīyate tenaivopāvahriyata ityacoditamapi vāsasa
